inv-overworld.text:
OVERWORLD HUD: every element of GameMenu.tsx and board.tsx has a place

Moved:
- Menu button + waiting count -> the trainer corner (bottom left), so the keypad grows out of it.
- Egg badge (top right) -> a progress ring round the trainer corner, plus its steps under the name.
- Gold (bar) -> under the name in the trainer corner.
- Place and weather button + popover -> a capsule at bottom centre that opens into a card in place; the windows become a grid of six.
- Field-move chips -> round buttons bottom right, where the thumb is.
- Fullscreen (bar) -> top-right corner, its usual place.
- Keypad tiles -> three labelled columns of rows (You, Play, Inbox), counts on the right; Settings and theme in its footer.

New (proposal): the trainer's name in the corner.
Dropped: nothing.

inv-sheet.text:
CATCH SHEET: every element of sheet.tsx and its sections has a place

Moved:
- Nameplate (name, species, gender, shiny) -> a hero header with the name large and the level as a tag.
- Portrait, chips, stars, sigil, HP and statuses -> the hero, beside the portrait.
- Tera type and candy + Level Up -> hero tiles on the right, the two things raised from here.
- Badges -> the hero; box chip and Actions -> top right with a close button.
- Stats -> left column, with a hexagon of the totals over the table (IV, EV inputs, Remaining, Undo, Save kept).
- Moves -> the centre as cards in a 3-wide grid, since they are what a player builds around; Abilities and Held items under them.
- Evolution -> right column as a vertical line with Evolve.
- Dock (ball, history line, History n, Close) -> an Origin card; Close -> the header.

New (proposal): the hexagon; move cards show type, category, power and PP.
Dropped: nothing. Shadow and In a raid badges appear when they apply.

inv-battle.text:
BATTLE: every element of the battle view, top bar, unit card and verdict has a place

Moved:
- Side meters -> your side top left, the foe mirrored top right, standing counts as ball pips.
- Title (or Replay, Awards nothing, speeds) -> a centre nameplate with the speeds under it.
- Leave -> bottom right, still confirmed.
- Unit card -> stays on hover; pressing a pokemon docks it as an inspector on the right with Open sheet (today the press opens the sheet straight away).
- Verdict dialog -> a results screen over the field: result, line, rewards, both teams, Best as a podium, Stay and look, Leave battle.

New (proposal): the gold damage trail; the inspector step before the sheet.
Kept: countdown, status line, leave confirmation.

inv-raid.text:
RAID: same components as Battle

Moved:
- The boss's wide meter -> a banner at top centre with the boss's face, name (Frenzy for a Noble) and its share left; the raid's title sits above the name.
- Your side's meter -> a plate bottom left with its standing count.
- Leave -> bottom right.

Kept: the Noble's burst ring, red marks and stagger stars; an Alpha's copies.
Proposals (Show proposals): a kind badge, ticks at 3/4, 1/2, 1/4, a callout when one is passed.
Not drawn: a party list or a timer, which the game has not got.

inv-motion.text: MOTION: every tile is a proposal. Today the game has fades of 250ms (dialogs, popovers), toast in and out, cell notes, the ball land and shake, bar width transitions and the button press. Reduce motion stays as it is: everything cut to a moment.

inv-phone.text: PHONE: these three still show today's phone layouts. They get the same redesign pass next, following the desktop boards once those are agreed.
